title: Health and Wellness — Honoring God with Your Body: Unit Quiz

questions.question: According to 1 Corinthians 6:19-20, why should Christians care for their physical bodies?
options: Because physical appearance determines your worth
Because your body is a temple of the Holy Spirit
Because God only blesses healthy people
Because exercise is required by Biblical law
questions.explanation: Paul teaches that the Christian's body is a temple of the Holy Spirit. Caring for your body is an act of worship and stewardship, honoring the God who created and redeemed you.

questions.question: What are the three macronutrients your body needs?
options: Vitamins, minerals, and water
Carbohydrates, proteins, and fats
Calcium, iron, and vitamin D
Fiber, sugar, and sodium
questions.explanation: The three macronutrients are carbohydrates (energy), proteins (building and repair), and fats (brain function and hormones). A balanced diet includes all three in appropriate proportions.

questions.question: What does Martyn Lloyd-Jones mean by 'preaching to yourself' rather than 'listening to yourself'?
options: Talking out loud instead of thinking silently
Ignoring all negative emotions completely
Actively speaking Biblical truth to counter anxious or hopeless thoughts
Only reading the Bible and never talking to other people
questions.explanation: Lloyd-Jones taught that we should actively speak Biblical truth to our emotions rather than passively accepting every anxious or hopeless thought. Our feelings are real but not always reliable guides to truth.

questions.question: What is the first rule of first aid?
options: Call 911 immediately
Begin CPR right away
Ensure your own safety before helping others
Move the injured person to safety
questions.explanation: The first rule of first aid is to ensure your own safety. You cannot help someone else if you become a victim yourself. Assess the scene for dangers before approaching.

questions.question: What does RICE stand for in treating sprains and strains?
options: Run, Ice, Compress, Exercise
Rest, Ice, Compress, Elevate
Relax, Immobilize, Cool, Examine
Rest, Isolate, Cover, Evaluate
questions.explanation: RICE stands for Rest the injured area, Ice it for 20 minutes at a time, Compress with an elastic bandage, and Elevate the injury above heart level.

questions.question: According to Proverbs 27:17, what is the purpose of close friendships?
options: To make life more fun and entertaining
To have someone who always agrees with you
To sharpen each other's character and faith
To ensure you are never alone
questions.explanation: Proverbs 27:17 says 'As iron sharpens iron, so one person sharpens another.' Healthy friendships challenge you to grow in character, wisdom, and faith, even when it involves honest friction.

questions.question: What is the difference between 'eustress' and chronic stress?
options: Eustress is imaginary; chronic stress is real
Eustress is positive, short-term stress that motivates; chronic stress is harmful, long-lasting stress
Eustress affects the body; chronic stress affects only the mind
There is no real difference between them
questions.explanation: Eustress is positive, short-term stress that motivates you to meet challenges. Chronic stress is harmful, long-lasting stress that damages physical health, mental well-being, and relationships.

questions.question: Why does the Bible instruct us to go directly to a person we have a conflict with (Matthew 18:15)?
options: To publicly shame them into changing
To address the issue honestly and seek resolution before it grows
To prove that you are right and they are wrong
To avoid involving any other people ever
questions.explanation: Jesus teaches us to go directly to the person to address the issue honestly and seek resolution. This prevents gossip, misunderstanding, and the buildup of resentment that damages relationships.

questions.question: What does Richard Swenson mean by 'margin' in the context of stress management?
options: The profit margin on financial investments
The space between your load and your limits — breathing room for rest and reflection
The border of a page in a notebook
The minimum grade needed to pass a class
questions.explanation: Swenson uses 'margin' to describe the breathing room between our load and our limits. Modern life often eliminates this margin, leaving no space for rest, reflection, or relationship with God.

questions.question: According to 1 Timothy 4:8, what is the proper Christian perspective on physical fitness?
options: Physical fitness is sinful and should be avoided
Physical fitness is the most important thing in life
Physical training has some value, but godliness has value for all things
Physical fitness is only important for athletes
questions.explanation: Paul acknowledges that physical training has genuine value while keeping it in proper perspective — godliness has value for all things, holding promise for both the present life and the life to come. The body matters, but the soul matters more.
